name: 07033 · Kenilworth, NJ
findings: ZIP 07033 (Kenilworth) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07033 (Kenilworth) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07033 (Kenilworth) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
